footer: Everything runs on this Mac. Jobs use your own CLI subscriptions.
checking.title: Checking this Mac
checking.body: Looking for Docker and a coding CLI.
docker_missing.title: Install Docker Desktop
docker_missing.body: Skynet runs its database and every job sandbox in Docker. Install Docker Desktop, open it once, then check again.
docker_stopped.title: Start Docker
docker_stopped.body: Docker is installed, but it is not running. Open Docker Desktop and wait until it says it is running.
no_cli.title: Install a coding CLI
no_cli.body: Skynet runs optimizations through a CLI you already pay for. Install one of these, then check again.
cli_too_old.title: Update your coding CLI
cli_too_old.body: Your CLI is older than the version Skynet needs. Run the update command, then check again.
not_logged_in.title: Sign in to your CLI
not_logged_in.body: The CLI is installed but not signed in. Run the command in Terminal, finish the sign-in, then check again.
not_logged_in.codex: {cli}: sign in with ChatGPT. An API key sign-in does not count. A login kept in the macOS Keychain does not count either: first set cli_auth_credentials_store = "file" in ~/.codex/config.toml.
rate_capped.title: Usage limit reached
rate_capped.body: Your CLI subscription reached its limit. New jobs can start again after the reset.
starting.title: Starting Skynet
starting.body: The first launch installs Python packages and builds the sandbox image. This can take several minutes.
ready.title: Skynet is ready
error.title: Skynet could not start
error.body: Fix the problem below, then try again. The logs have the full output.
